name: CloudHQ FRA Campus Offenbach
notes: Official CloudHQ campus page says the Offenbach campus has two 56 MW critical IT-load buildings, fully permitted and powered by an on-site 110 kV substation; city page described both buildings at about 112 MW IT load and 172 MW connected load.

name: CloudHQ FRA7 Campus Offenbach
notes: Official CloudHQ page lists FRA7 in Offenbach with 90 MW total critical IT load, development planned to begin in 2027 and service in 2029; trade press reported the related Kettelerstrasse/Akzo Nobel redevelopment with roughly 93 MW and earliest operation 2027/2028.

name: Vantage Frankfurt I / FRA1 Campus
notes: Official Vantage materials place the Frankfurt I campus at Goethering 27, 63067 Offenbach am Main. Vantage announced the second of three facilities on its flagship Offenbach FRA1 campus in 2022; the campus is described as 55-56 MW critical IT capacity.

name: maincubes FRA01
notes: maincubes lists FRA01 as in operation with 6 MW capacity; PeeringDB confirms the facility address as Goethering 29, Offenbach, DE. Directory sources also identify it as Frankfurt FRA01 in Offenbach.

name: Rheingau-Taunus-Kreis county-owned data center, Bad Schwalbach
notes: County privacy page states the district website is hosted in the county's own data center at Bad Schwalbach. No public capacity figure found.

name: Vogelsbergkreis district administration data center geothermal cooling pilot
notes: DataCenter-Insider reported the Vogelsbergkreis district administration installed geothermal cooling for server racks in its Landratsamt data center, reducing cooling electricity use and CO2 emissions. No commercial/hyperscale project found.

name: Bad Vilbel-Massenheim Datacenter
notes: Local reports say Wetteraukreis handed over the building permit for Bad Vilbel's first data center in Massenheim; planned IT area about 7,200 sqm, electrical connection 30 MVA, IT load 21 MW.

name: Karben-Rendel / Schultheisenwiese data center
developer: BlackRock Real Estate and Kauri CAB
notes: IZ Research summary identifies a Karben-Rendel project with up to 33 MW IT load by BlackRock Real Estate and Kauri CAB. Municipal planning documents for B-Plan Nr. 244 Schultheisenwiese reference Rechenzentrum planning and technical studies; local press says a data center is to be built on the former nursery site outside Rendel.

name: firstcolo FRA7 Rosbach vor der Höhe
notes: firstcolo announced ground-breaking in Rosbach on 2026-06-15 with around EUR250m investment; SPIE says the FRA7 project is designed for 16 MW IT load and should be completed by the end of 2028. firstcolo marketing also describes 24 MW total capacity, so 16 MW IT load is recorded as the conservative capacity figure.

name: Colt DCS Frankfurt 4 and Frankfurt 5, Wiesbaden
notes: Colt DCS says it secured a Wiesbaden site east of central Frankfurt for Frankfurt 4 and 5; Data Center Dynamics reported Colt's Wiesbaden data center development and quoted Wiesbaden's mayor, with the two sites contributing to 63 MW IT power.

name: WiTCOM DataCenter services / WiTCOM DataCenter 2
developer: WiTCOM Wiesbadener Informations- und Telekommunikations GmbH
notes: City/municipal company pages describe WiTCOM as offering data center and colocation services in Wiesbaden; DataCenterMap identifies WiTCOM DataCenter 2 as a Wiesbaden data center established in 1999. No public MW capacity found.

name: You Logic AG certified data center, Wiesbaden
notes: You Logic states it provides DATEV hosting on dedicated and virtual servers in a certified data center in Wiesbaden and describes secure operation on its own servers. No public capacity figure found.

name: Lunecon Rechenzentrum Westerstede
notes: Lunecon's official pages list Rechenzentrum services from Westerstede and state staff work on customer infrastructure and the firm's own data center; contact page places the company at Danziger Str. 6, 26655 Westerstede. No public capacity figure found.

name: OMG.DE / Emsnet Rechenzentrum Aurich-Ostfriesland
notes: OMG.DE/Emsnet official pages state they operate their own data center at the Aurich-Ostfriesland site, offering hosting, vServer, rackspace and server housing. No public capacity figure found.
